reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Chris Belknap
reviews.text: Took a vehicle here on a test drive for a pre purchase inspection. They got me in quickly and confirmed issues with significant rust and advised against purchasing the truck. Appreciated their help and great service. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Dart Martino
reviews.text: Ive gone to clayton tire multiple times over the years because my father knows the owner, but that is a thing of the past. EVERY SINGLE TIME i get something done there its WRONG. I got 2 new tires. Theyre in the Wrong place and incredibly out of balance. Another time the man upfront bet me 1 million dollars you could flip the steering wheel of a 99 honda accord without unhooking from the rack and pinion. Which I proceeded to do it myself in the parking lot in 20 minutes without disconnecting it from the rack. A bunch of bozos work their. Spend the extra dollar somewhere else and have it done right

reviews.author: Edna Spivey
reviews.text: They were very rude on the phone with me when trying to find their location... Rented a u-haul...Was suppose to have been one way.. but he said we would have to bring it back to his location... That making me have to pay for mileage when it was returned... Called field manager and over- rode him..

reviews.author: Alan Michael Woods
reviews.text: I had a great experience here renting a uhaul on two different occasions. Mr. Chris was very nice in helping with my uhaul reservation, pick-up and drop-off. They have a lot of uhaul trucks available and Mr. Chris helped with that selection and gave great advice.

reviews.author: Scottie Bullock
reviews.text: Awesome customer service. My first time visiting Clayton tire and muffler. Asked them if they install bus tires and they said yes and quoted me a price and started right away. Very affordable install for 6 tires. Thank you Clayton tire and muffler

reviews.author: Andrew Fister
reviews.text: Great Tire shop!! The Owner Terry was super understanding when I ordered the wrong tires from Tire Rack. I got new tires the next day and they got me in immediately. This was a life saving kindness since my tires were bald amd rain was coming very soon. Great Shop. I would recommend this great shop super nice and understanding!!!

reviews.author: Kyle Larson
reviews.text: Had an issue with my vehicle seemingly making more road noise than I'm used to. Clayton Tire & Muffler got me in the next morning (on a weekend!), took a few hours for test drive and a once-over. I came back to pick it up and had my wallet out ready to pay a minimum of $100 for their time, but I was told it would be *NO charge* because they couldn't find a problem. They were clear with me that it doesn't mean there *isn't* a problem, but that there wasn't one they could find and that my tires might be wearing unevenly, but they wouldn't change anything at this moment. Five stars for honesty, and five more for integrity!

reviews.author: Will Smith
reviews.text: I called to get a quote to have my break bada replaced. He quickly tried to upcharge me saying we need to replaced the rotors(keep in mind he hasn’t seen my rotors) said he wouldn’t do it if the rotors weren’t replaced. He clearly stated that “he doesn’t do what the customers want” good luck with that business model. I found a shop down the street that would do it for me. They said the rotors were fine. Look else where if you don’t want to get taken advantage of.

reviews.author: Chelsea Sparling
reviews.text: I knew going into this, I should listen to the reviews, but they were the only place contracted with Tire Rack anywhere near my house. So, here I am, regretting not just shipping my wheels to my house and having them done elsewhere. I talked to them THREE different times to verify that they were going to make sure the TPMS would be programmed. The first time I called, I could barely understand the guy and he had no idea what I was talking about even though the shipping label on the tires says TPMS sensors were included. He kept saying he didn’t see anything about the TPMS but they were PROBABLY in the tires already (wasn’t aware until this point that TR sent the tires already mounted to my new rims). Didn’t help that he spoke to me like I’M the idiot. Okay, cool, whatever. Second time I called, after consulting with Tire Rack and making sure the sensors were installed in the tires, I told them they’d need to make sure to program the TPMS. A different guy tells me that he’s done THOUSANDS of TPMS installs and it’ll be done properly. Also treated me like an idiot for even calling to ask about it. Ok, good to know, felt better about it being done at least. I go to pick up my car and ask again if they were programmed, he assures me that all I need to do is just drive the car and it’ll re-program automatically. Welp, now here we are. My car not only has an alert for the TPMS not working correctly, but also feels unstable while driving at high speeds. So, here I am, having to take my car back to another shop to fix what Clayton Muffler didn’t want to do and paying double for the same service and hoping they didn’t screw up something else on my car. Believe the low ratings, people, they’re here for a reason. If they can’t even mount tires correctly, I wouldn’t trust them to do ANYTHING.

reviews.author: John Feagans
reviews.text: I've been a customer since they were in their original location and have never had a bad experience. I've gotten tires, had them work on existing tire issues, had vehicles repaired and gotten inspections and they've always been extremely professional and reasonably priced. Terry and his team have worked me in when I was in a bind and helped me locate U-Hauls at other location when they didn't have what I needed on their lot. I can't understand all of the bad reviews but I suspect it has more to do with those customers than actual issues with this company. Give them a try and you'll be glad that you did.

reviews.author: Robert Bell
reviews.text: I went here to get new exhaust tips welded onto my Fiero GT and they did a great job. I'll be sure to come back for all my exhaust needs in the future. Thanks!

reviews.author: J Forbes
reviews.text: Chris and Terry were so helpful and kind. They do great work over there! You can trust them with your auto needs and they have moving trucks. Their communication was great and I will definitely be back when I need them again.

reviews.author: Melody FromHeaven
reviews.text: I recently rented a U-Haul from here and that will definitely be my last time. The customer service is non-existent! I was treated like I was problem just because I was there. After declining the damage waiver insurance at checkout, I was still charged for it on the back end. When I called to question that, they acted like they didn't know what I was talking about. I was even more of a problem then. NEVER AGAIN! If you don't like ALL people, you shouldn't be working with the public!

reviews.author: Melissa Maiorino
reviews.text: Upon my recommendation l, referred my fiancé to Clayton Tire and Muffler. I originally chose them to work on my truck based on being a local, family owned business. Even though they always took longer than they anticipated to get the work done, I kept going throughout the years. Recently I referred my fiancé there to get new tires. He had just recently had an alignment elsewhere and had new steering arms and tie rod ends and ball joints replaced. After he left with his new tires, his truck's steering was wonk and it was floating all over the road. He had to be somewhere and couldn't go back but called to let them know something was wrong. After going in with the bent metal crossbar and having a evaluation report from another mechanic that the truck was obviously dropped on the lift or jacked up from the cross bar, Terry would not take accountability for his shops mistake. This costs us 2k to fix and was 100% the fault of this shop. I am very disappointed as I have used this mechanic as well as many of my friends and family and trusted them. Mistakes happen, and when they do, I feel that businesses should make it right. I do NOT recommend trusting this business with your vehicle.

reviews.author: TJ Micheals
reviews.text: Called and made an appointment to have my vehicle aligned. When I arrived for the appointment, they had not placed me on the calendar. I then left my vehicle until the following day. Came back to see if it was done the next day and it was not. I then left it over the weekend and they eventually got to it that Monday. Finally got it aligned and just the other day when I was parked with the wheels at full crank, I notice the nuts on my tie rods were not tight. Glad I noticed it. Really let me down and I shouldn’t have to go behind a shop’s work that I paid to do a service.

reviews.author: Joseph Seba
reviews.text: I took my 2014 Camaro in for a wheel balance and alignment. Great customer service, although I had to wait a couple hours because they were in the middle of another job when I showed up. But overall the price was decent and when they did the work, they didn't have a problem with me looking in on the process and seeing for myself if there was any issues. I'll likely go back to get new tires, although we all know tires from a shop are more expensive than ordering them online. The owner offered to allow me to ship whatever tires I found directly to the shop though, and only charge for installation, and he told me to let him know what prices I was able to find online and if he could, he'd try to beat them. Either way works for me.

reviews.author: Shaunte Crowell
reviews.text: The only reason for this 1 star is how quick they are to get your vehicle in the shop so they can charge you unnecessarily. I was recommended here from someone off Nextdoor app but I wish I would've done my due diligence and checked around. My honda had a slow leak so I was advised to purchase a new hose. I wanted convenience over quality and ended up spending over $600 to STILL have the same problem. Initially, at the shop, I was told I needed an electronic valve and had to wait for the part to come the next day. I also asked for an oil change which they failed to perform. Parts and labor for this 1st service came to almost 3 something. Not even a full day after picking my vehicle up, the check engine light came on again, something was still leaking, and I had to get a tow due to the car jerking the following day. I immediately contacted the guy who performed services and was told to get it to them and they would get right on it. I assumed the problem would be fixed and complimentary since my car wasn't doing this before but I was wrong again. I questioned the services and asked them to stop working on it immediately once I found out what they were charging me and immediately began getting disrespected. Customer service is definitely something they need to add to their list of things to fix. So here I am, after two visits and a tow, looking for a reliable shop to fix the problem that they couldn't.

reviews.author: Parker Eaton
reviews.text: Picked up a U-Haul auto transport trailer from Clayton Tire and Muffler for a track weekend early morning at 8 am. Cory was great! Guided me back to the trailer and hitched it up and gave me some pointers. Would rent again from them in the future!

reviews.author: Rae Oh
reviews.text: We picked up our U-Haul from this location, but when we asked if they could do a quick oil change for my car at the same time they were immediately able to take care of us! Very appreciative that they were able to make our moving experience a little easier.

reviews.author: William Nelson
reviews.text: I needed my rear tires replaced due to uneven wear so I had my order shipped here for install. The sitting area is comfortable and staff friendly. Even though they were a little backed up in about an hour and a half they got me done and out. Prices are reasonable and I would recommend them for your tire needs. If I need anything the dealer doesn't cover I'll be heading here first.

reviews.author: Daniela Villamizar
reviews.text: I've never experienced such poor and rude customer service since I moved here to Clayton. The owners have zero good attitude and willingness to help the customer; they are unfriendly and even rude. In my case, the lady got frustrated because she couldn't understand what I was asking, perhaps due to my accent; additionally, she couldn't find me on the reservation list that I had previously made, which I was on; it's just that she had a bad attitude from the moment I arrived asking for her help. If you're not willing to help anyone, then don't work with the public and go home. I will never return to that place in my life, it's unpleasant and the poor service from both owners makes it even worse!

reviews.author: Nicholas Satter
reviews.text: Went to get a U-Haul and waited 15-20 mins for them to finish conversing about antiques/animals with another person only to be told truck wasn’t there. Not upset about truck not being available just wish that they would acknowledge the customer and prioritize customer service over (what appeared to be) personal conversation.

reviews.author: Alisha Maria
reviews.text: Save yourself stressed & money. Definitely don’t buy a battery from him! Go to an auto store! The give you your core fee & put the battery in FOR FREE! Was charged 66 bucks to do a 5 min job, wasn’t given my core fee but was told he got that even though I bought the battery & was charged by him for it. He quoted me a price online for 4 things only 2 were done & my bill was 30 bucks less than what he quoted me & 1 wasn’t done was 50 bucks alone without the 4 job that wasn’t completed. I’m I my glad the other 2 wasn’t completed because I probably couldn’t have paid the bill if he did all 4 things in the original quote. Be aware especially if you’re a single female whose family is hours away.

reviews.author: Wes Melvin
reviews.text: I love this place. They keep a lot of old-timers there and it shows a lot of respect. For a lost art, I love looki. Ng at older historic looking buildings. I'm watching work. It done in a timely manner. Great prices.Good deals.Honest will always go here

reviews.author: Ronald Marchesano
reviews.text: Really nice people are employed there that go the extra mile. We pulled in with a u-haul trailer and the mechanic went out in the rain to detach it from the tow vehicle. Soaking wet, he still had a great attitude saving me from attempting doing something I knew very little about. Legitimately, they are allowed to charge the customer to disconnect the equipment if necessary. I am grateful they didn't. Clayton Tire and Muffler offers uhaul rentals as well as being a full service repair shop in a convenient location on the 70 in Clayton.

reviews.author: Stephen Maiorino
reviews.text: RUN! I really wanted to continue taking my jeep here being a small, local, family owned shop- but everytime I have I am told it will take a certain amount of time and it's always longer. Overpriced and have screwed over a friend I had recommended to them which cost her 2k dollars. Go elsewhere.

reviews.author: Andy
reviews.text: Stay far away. Takes forever to get parts. Owner constantly lying about how long it will be. Charged me for work I did not authorize. On top of all of that the ONE thing I asked them to do was done incorrectly. I had to pay another shop to fix their mistake.

reviews.author: Jason Nardi
reviews.text: Very poor customer service and all I did was rent a U-Haul Van. It seems that they completely forgot to do all of the things we agreed to when I picked up the vehicle - I even left a note on the key when I dropped it off to remind them - Placed in the owner's hands too. I know it wasn't the normal routine, and I could have ignored it all, but when the owner tells you they won't do what they promised originally I have to call them on their integrity & lack of customer service.

reviews.author: Joseph Thompson
reviews.text: If I could give zero stars I would. Had an appt, dropped off at 10 to leave with them for “1.5 hours”. No follow up calls all day. Starting calling at 3 for an update… not ready, will be another “1.5” hours. 6pm pickup and NOTHING had been done. This place has always and will be a cluster.

reviews.author: Rebecca Morgan
reviews.text: Unexpectedly horrible service. I brought my vehicle not once but three times to this garage, with appointments being made, and all three times, they were “too busy” to look at my car and get anything done! My car sat all day, while they took other vehicles ahead of my scheduled vehicle. My check engine light was on. I just needed diagnostics. Not only did they not complete any work, but they lost my extended warranty paperwork! When I asked the manager for an explanation, he didn’t have one. Simply pathetic and poor business service!

reviews.author: Eva Zeron
reviews.text: I have been here twice in the past 5 weeks for two unrelated matters. Both times I was helped immediately and I only waited 20-25 minutes per visit. It’s clear that customer service is their top priority. Prices are more than reasonable. I will continue to use their services.

reviews.author: Shaun Almada
reviews.text: They knew I was desperate because I was using credit cards and i mentioned this was the only place within my range for AAA towing but then it took me 2-3 weeks to get my car back and for my 20 year-old Taurus the alternator, a starter, and an air pump was $1,368. The original estimate was about a thousand. This review is coming somewhat late it has been about a month but my car isn't starting again and another mechanic informed me how much I was ripped off after seeing that bill. The mechanic I was corresponding with over the phone was nice however which is why I'm giving two stars instead of one.

reviews.author: Amy Kanode
reviews.text: Bad service. Was recommended this place for reasonable price, but went out of my way twice to get work done and owner never remembered my appointment or ordered part TWICE. When questioning him why not or what went wrong, never apologized or tried to make right. Stated, "honey, i speak to tons of people everyday" never followed up with me after calling multiple times....as if he didn't care about having my business....going somewhere else for now on. lost my business

reviews.author: Brock Sawyer
reviews.text: Great people to work with. Fully trusted them with my daughter's Volvo XC90 with 240K+ on it. Replaced the throttle body and we should be good to go now. Highly recommend Clayton Tire and Muffler. Richard and Terry are wonderful and will do you right.

reviews.author: Crystal Williams
reviews.text: I showed up today in a panic. These guys have worked on our cars for years, but they do not know me. I always send my bf or son because as a woman I don’t want to be taken advantage of, I’m clueless when it comes to cars. I’m blown away by my experience today! I honestly have no other words but THANK YOU!! I’ll never hesitate bringing another vehicle in myself.

reviews.author: Wil Rios
reviews.text: I have two experiences the Clayton Tire and Muffler. The first was a Uhaul rental where the tail lights did not work. Obviously, the safety check was not performed, and had to pick the rental from another Uhaul dealer. More recently, for some exhaust work. It was a less than honest experience. I took my business elsewhere. I will not be giving them another chance.

reviews.author: Nancy Roberts
reviews.text: I can’t speak for their auto work, but I would suggest not renting a U-haul at this location. The pick-up was fine, and the employee was pleasant and helpful; however, the drop off was horrendous. I parked the trailer exactly where I picked it up from then some guy comes out yelling. “Just put it anywhere.” I can’t really hear him, so I get out and walk towards him. He starts talking in an aggressive, threatening manner. I am confused, but then I realized he doesn’t want the trailer there because he thinks it’s blocking traffic. While fine, move it. Or, you could have told me ahead of time. That’s not the issue. (But there was plenty of room for a driver of average skill to pull through). This guy starts backing up towards me as I am trying to figure out for what I am being chastised. This guy nearly runs me over. Then I am at his window and he rolls over the tip of my foot with his tire. It was a graze and not painful, so not a giant deal, except that’s battery. By now I’m fully enraged, and go inside to complain, where yes, I was upset and raised my voice a bit to the woman inside who had nothing to do with the situation, and she says understandably, “don’t yell at me”. I said, “you are right, I’m not yelling at you I’m upset.” But, then she continues, because don’t you take a tone with me I’m not in the mood for it, my leg hurts! Wait what?!? Clearly, the customer service issues go all the way up. Customer service these days has just gone to the birds. Just take warning if you deal with the business. You may be assaulted and nearly run over.

reviews.author: Lewis M Bowers Sr
reviews.text: They do a good job every time I go. I have been there several times. The last time I was here, they refused to do the state inspection on my class B RV which is a large van. You can park it in a normal parking space. They said you had to have a place big enough to pull it in to inspect it. As I was leaving, I saw two Bay's way big enough to pull the Van in. They have inspected my van before and my two other vehicles. I bought tires and catholic tic converters for my van. I will be taking all my business somewhere else.

reviews.author: Tonya
reviews.text: Never, ever go to Clayton Tire and Muffler. They keep your car all day, literally from 9 am to 5 pm just to rotate the tires. I've tried calling them to see when my car will be ready, but no one will answer the phone. They have horrible service. Don't go ever to them!! You'll regret it! The man who works there was mad at ME for hanging up on him after he told me they had tried calling me, when they hadn't! I've had my phone with me all day and they have called me not one time!! Supposedly, they closed at one but waited til we picked up the car. It was 5:00 when we finally were able to pick it up. Then when my husband went to pay, the man said he wasn't going to accept his money because he didn't appreciate me hanging up him! I hung up on him because he told me he had tried calling me, but I told him there was no way he had because I had had my phone with me all day. Then he said, "Well, that's beside the point!". Yeah, I hung up on you! I'm the customer, dude!! You're not a little boy who got his feelings hurt. You were rude to me! Your bread and butter!

reviews.author: Monica Fields
reviews.text: I got a flat tire on US70 after doing a grocery pick up order. I was trying to get home to my daughter. Luckily I pulled over into this shop. They had just opened. They were willing to put my spare on quickly and for free. Thank you for your help!

reviews.author: Steve Polenz
reviews.text: These folks are awsome. They donated a u haul to help with the efforts going on in the mountains of NC! Go see Chris to get a muffler, tires, or a UHaul! Thanks so much for supporting the community!

reviews.author: Agustin
reviews.text: The customer service was horrible, I highly would not recommend to anyone. I tried to ask a few questions because yes I am a little younger and the guy there said and I quote, "Look, you're asking too many questions". I was just simply trying to learn more about the tire sizes. I went to get new tires and the gentleman there said he had the tires I wanted then said he didn't have them. After that he put smaller tires on my car which eventually caused me to rotate my tires since it was giving me problems. I will not be going there ever again.

reviews.author: princessncntrol G
reviews.text: Had to go to this location to pick up a car dolly. After being treated horribly by Barbel at Kelly's Karz @4086 NC 42 hwy W. Garner,NC. We had originally planned to rent from there. Husband hooked up dolly the R light did not work. When this was brought up to her. She replied with "Go home call U-haul roadside. I wouldn't allow my husband to leave. An hour and change later roadside shows up. And said we couldn't use it. Faulty wiring. Barbel, said well not our equipment. Thus how we ended up at Clayton Tire. Very helpful, very nice. Will use them again.

reviews.author: Darryl Miller
reviews.text: Clayton Tire and muffler center were very honest and personal service. Gave us all the information we need to know about attaching a hitch to our new car and help us save money by giving us good advice thank you, guys.

reviews.author: Justin Runyon
reviews.text: I’ve been going to Clayton Tire for 10+ years now. Every time I have experienced an honest, reliable, and efficient service. Terry is a great and personable owner who cares about his customers and his business. If you go anywhere else, you’re taking a chance.

reviews.author: Donald
reviews.text: I ordered 2 front tires on the 20th of May 2022 and I was told the tires would be in Monday the 23rd of May 2022. I was told I will get a call when the 2 tires come in on Monday. However, I had to call on the 26th and was told the tires where at the shop. So, I called Saturday 28th at 8:15Am no one answered the phone. I showed up to the shop at 8:25AM and everyone is standing around doing nothing. Some of the tech's where in there vehicles eating. I made an appointment an 11AM appointment and now they say my tires want be in until next Tuesday after memorial day. Plus tires cost $505 plus taxes mount balance come up to over $700. I found a shop that's a lot cheaper than this company. Thanks for allowing me to search for a better company.

reviews.author: Kyle Wilson
reviews.text: I have only used their UHAUL service here, so I can only speak to that. Their customer service is excellent. They always get me checked out quickly without hassles. Also they accommodated a few special requests of mine from time-to-time. I will continue to rent trucks and trailers from Clayton Tire and Muffler.

reviews.author: Dan Stahl
reviews.text: Rude and obnoxious on the phone. No people skills, whatsoever. Tried setting an appointment for my son's truck who is in the military and on limited time to return to base. I was told he was backed up for two weeks. I asked if it was possible to fit him in because.of his schedule. He told me he didn't care. Obviously not one ounce of respect.

reviews.author: Tim King
reviews.text: RUN! Trust me, do yourself a favor and find another mechanic before even thinking of taking your car here. I had my car towed there to have my starter replaced...simple, right? Well 3 days and 5 phone calls later, he hadn't even looked at it!! Every time, and I mean every time I called Terry would answer and say he was with a customer and couldn't even answer a simple question as to when my car would be ready. He always said he would call back and never did - 0 out of 5 times! On the 3rd day and 5th call from me, I asked if my car was ready, he again said he was with a customer. When I told him I was a customer too and had been waiting 3 days he yelled and said he didn't have time for me because he was with a customer! At that point, I had it immediately towed to another mechanic. This guy can't even get a starter replaced within 3 days! On top of that, treats his customers horribly. As a business owner, I get that times can get hectic, but when you own a business and you rely on your custmers and after 30 years in the auto repair business, you should know that you have to hire more help if you can't handle the business. Don't push your poorly managed business practices on your customers. Funny thing is, when I talked with the tow truck guy who's towing it to another mechanic, he mentioned how horrible Clayton Tire and Muffler is. He said Clayton Tire has been sending some of their cars to another mechicanic in town because Clayton Tire doesn't know how to fix it! That speaks volumes!! So, if you value your time, your car, and want to be treated ethically, go somewhere else. There are so many more reliable mechanics around town than this guy.

reviews.author: Sydney Hall Lara
reviews.text: Called to ask if they could change my car battery due to the odd placement of the battery in my car. The older gentlemen who answered just corrected me and was very condescending. I just need HELP! Not more condescension from someone. No I don’t know everything about cars, but that does not mean you can be rude to me! DO BETTER!!!!

reviews.author: Cody Williams
reviews.text: Bottom line up front: Terrible customer service. 0-3 on "I'll call you back" and discarded a tire I wanted back regardless of repair status. No compensation offered. I will not be back. My father-in-law dropped my tire off for repair while I was out of town. He picked the tire up several days later after it had yet not been looked at. He told me not to go back and that they clearly weren't interested in running a business. I gave them the benefit of the doubt and went back. The owner told me he would have his guy look at my tire and call me back when it was repaired or if it could not be repaired. I told him if it could not be repaired I wanted it back. A week later I hadn't heard anything, so I called and he said he'd have to go look for it in the trash pile. Again, no call back for another week. I went back after two weeks and he'd had the tire disposed of. 0-3 on "I'll call you back" and disposed of a tire I wanted back regardless of repair status. I will not use them again.

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text: Excellent service!!! Will absolutely go back! We did a pre purchase inspection and we're greatful to them for working us in so quickly!

reviews.author: Robert Brady
reviews.text: They were able to get my tires the next day and had them mounted and ready to go by noon. Terry and crew are friendly and keep things moving even when shop is extremely busy.

reviews.author: Rudy
reviews.text: I was told being my car in on a Wednesday to get brakes pads replaced and to pick it up on Friday. Went to pick up my car Friday about 4:30pm and it was not ready he said he just looked at it about 20 minutes before I got there. Wow had it for 3 days and could not get the work done. So I called back on Saturday and he wanted me to bring the car in and he had the parts but he got the parts late at 12pm and they were going to close at 1pm. So he said bring it in any time Monday. Ok I called Monday he said I can do it this morning 2 hrs to get it done. It th poke the mechanic 5hrs to replace my brake pads turn 3 rotors and replace 1 caliper. The mechanic said he is the only mechanic working there the other ones are tire mans. Waited from 8:45am to 2pm 5 hrs and 15 min ago. I would not reccomend this place to anyone. Terry was very rude slow mechanic and can not give you a date and keep it to fix your car. Just stop it off and pray that it will get fixed that day. DO not bring ANY Car to Clayton Tires they Suck. If you are retired and have plenty of time that you can sit and wait forever pls dont because forever is a long time.

reviews.author: Al Beth
reviews.text: Was a walk in customer and was trying was treated very nicely. Helped right away. Problem couldn't be fixed today ,but diagnosed and parts ordered. Long time business establishment. Modern service with small town, old fashioned service. Terry ,the owner,is very nice. Cannot ask for better treatment .

reviews.author: Richard Bruce
reviews.text: I've been there several times for small ATV and mower sized tires..always a walk-in. They take me right away and the prices are VERY reasonable and they seem to be the only shop in the area that will even touch them. Great customer service!

reviews.author: vicfishing 1 y más
reviews.text: Very bad service today I had a bad experience at this place and without honestly I would never return this place. It was all thick when I made an appointment to be able to repair my muffler truck and I arrived at the office and everything was going well an hour passed two hours three hours and in these three hours I asked how long it would take and they just told me a little more and at In the end he decides to leave the place and an employee told me that the person in charge of repairing mufflers was not there and I thought why they did not tell me that when I made the appointment or when I was waiting 3 hours, I do not recommend this terrible service.

reviews.author: Jarred Daughtry
reviews.text: This guy is a complete crook. Do not do business here. Shop around. He has lures me down there from Smithfield with the promise of a reasonably priced job I. E. (Muffler delete)... Wait around over an hour then tell me 250$ to weld in a 2 foot strait piece of pipe ... Bad business bad people

reviews.author: Owen Linfield
reviews.text: It took them 2 months to run a diagnostic. They scratched my paint and couldn't even put my steering column back together. Now my truck is nowhere near mint condition, but I believe that they should treat every costumer's vehicle with respect. I wouldn't even trust these guys to change my oil and remember to put clean oil back in.

reviews.author: ANITA ANTONE
reviews.text: Fair price for good work done. Was honest about what repairs really were needed. Had to call them to confirm work was finished which was only issue, still would use again.

reviews.author: Pray4u Lee
reviews.text: This place is awesome my tire pressure was on 20%. I drove in and there was a nail in my tire I don't know. It took them less than 15 minutes and they put air in my tires.

reviews.author: pam smith
reviews.text: We were from out of town. They moved us ahead and figured out the problem and had us ready to go within an hour. The staff and service were excellent and I would highly recommend this business and the staff to everyone. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Vee L
reviews.text: Just moved to Clayton almost a year ago and don’t know much around here. I went here due to a noise coming from my car they are great and get the job done in a decent amount of time and at a decent price! I will be back!

reviews.author: Brandon Lambert
reviews.text: Jimmy was awesome! Good customer service isn’t easy to find these days but Jimmy Went above and beyond to fix my leaky rim that other shops Couldn’t/wouldn’t fix. I ll be bringing all my vehicles to Jimmy from here on out!

reviews.author: Max Mooneyham
reviews.text: Go elsewhere. They may have the cheapest price, but their service is very bad. They cracked my rim, made every excuse you could imagine, but would not make it right. Terry is less than honest. I made the mistake, you don't have to too. GO ELSEWHERE!

reviews.author: Silencer King
reviews.text: Very pleased. I went to get my car inspection. The service was very quick and the lady in the front office was delightful. This is my new place to go.

reviews.author: Kelly
reviews.text: Honest and have good prices. I had a problem with my tire and they fit me in that day and had it fixed in no time. I've also rented Uhauls from them.

reviews.author: Natalie
reviews.text: Always get my oil changed here, and tires rotated. Terry and his crew do a good job. They are very busy, but always fit me in.

reviews.author: brendan bolen
reviews.text: told me i could do a walk in with no appointment so i drove an hour there, then they tell me i have to make an appointment so i go back the next day for an appointment and they tell me they can’t do it when it’s a simple exhaust job on my car and all they said is “we can’t do it, your cars being pulled outside.” 4 hours of driving wasted. they have no clue what they are doing and bad customer service

reviews.author: Jared Dooley
reviews.text: Went here to get two mufflers on my car. Poor welding and was way too expensive for the work that was done. I went to Henry’s muffler shop and they said I would of paid around 200 but Clayton tire and muffler made me pay 470 for Henry to fix it.

reviews.author: Jesse Schulman
reviews.text: Old school mechanic shop, looks like it hasn't changed much since the 90s. Excellent service and very friendly with good prices. Would go back again, especially for tire work.

reviews.author: James Ramsey
reviews.text: We use these guys regularly. Great people, locally owned and operated. Never had any problems with their work or service.

reviews.author: Kenza Bo
reviews.text: BEST REPAIR SHOP IN TOWN . I have always fixed my car's tires there and i always get the best service . I curbed my car few days ago and they fixed the car for me FOR FREE !!

reviews.author: Daddy Duck02 (Daddyduck02)
reviews.text: Went there to have an inspection on my vehicle. People there very friendly and knowable. I didn’t expect them to drop everything that they were doing but I was in and out in no time. Will be using them regularly.

reviews.author: Madison Davis
reviews.text: Fast, efficient, and very nice staff. Had a great experience and will be returning when I need new tires!

reviews.author: Raoul Sosa
reviews.text: I scheduled a 10:30 appointment the day before, I show up and I'm told Come back in an HOUR!! I told the customer service guy i only have an Hour Break, he gave me a bunch of excuses and couldn't answer simple questions.. i walked OUT!!

reviews.author: Del
reviews.text: Awesome staff, picked up truck and trailer. Even though they were extra busy they took time out to help me maneuver to leave.

reviews.author: Douglas Rorbah
reviews.text: I bring all 4 of vehicles here for my inspections for the last 4 years. A good experience Everytime.

reviews.author: Chris Williams
reviews.text: I have been going to Clayton Tire for years and always have a good experience when I do. The owner is always there, is friendly, and will listen to you if you have concerns.

reviews.author: George Rollins (Vreedan)
reviews.text: Terry is very honest and works very hard to ensure everyone is taken care of. He treats my wife like family.

reviews.author: Bazberner
reviews.text: Very happy with how things went with my truck tires. Great local place that can save you a lot of money!

reviews.author: Emory O'Dell
reviews.text: Very good service. I'm on a fleet service account and that can be aggravating but they was wonderful!

reviews.author: Josh Anderson
reviews.text: Spend your money locally. Got a good deal on tires and they were quick to change them out. Nice folks.

reviews.author: Round Rock Construction, LLC
reviews.text: Just needed a NC State inspection...Quick service, completed as needed, and great reading material too.

reviews.author: Lacey Rae
reviews.text: They charged me for an inspection when I didn't need one and didn't say a word about it, then the owner asked me to tip him. Will not be going back here.

reviews.author: Bryan Mclamb
reviews.text: I do a lot of business with this company on the commercial tire side. They take great care of me and my company!

reviews.author: Diana Gutiérrez
reviews.text: Very bad costumer service by phone. They hang on you. With that experience I won't even try to get any service
